items.source: Generate a bean name for the given bean definition.
items.translation: 为给定的 Bean 定义生成一个 Bean 名称。

items.source: definition - the bean definition to generate a name for
items.translation: definition - 要生成名称的 Bean 定义

items.source: registry - the bean definition registry that the given definition is supposed to be registered with
items.translation: registry - 给定定义预期注册到的 Bean 定义注册表

items.source: Strategy interface for generating bean names for bean definitions.
items.translation: 用于为 Bean 定义生成 Bean 名称的策略接口。
